description: Open Payment Recording Modal from staff portal
expected: Modal renders with title "Record Payment" and exact balance "₹237.00"
actual: Title: "Record Payment", Displayed Balance: "₹237.00"

description: Attempt to record payment exceeding remaining balance (₹500 vs ₹237 balance)
expected: Form submission blocked with explicit error: "Payment cannot exceed outstanding balance of ₹237.00"
actual: Error text displayed: "Payment cannot exceed outstanding balance of ₹237.00"

description: Submit UPI payment with missing UTR reference number
expected: Blocked with error: "Please enter the UPI 12-digit UTR or Transaction reference number for verification"
actual: Error text displayed: "Please enter the UPI 12-digit UTR or Transaction reference number for verification"

description: Record partial payment of ₹100.00 via UPI (UTR: 428901234567)
expected: Success banner confirms ₹100.00 recorded; modal automatically transitions order state
actual: Success message: "Payment of ₹100.00 recorded successfully!"

description: Order table updates post partial payment
expected: Order reflects partial payment of ₹100.00, remaining balance ₹137.00, status partially_paid
actual: Verified: Order reflected partial payment and remaining balance

description: Record remaining ₹137.00 balance via Cash Collected
expected: Remaining balance settled in full; order transitions to paid
actual: Success message: "Payment of ₹137.00 recorded successfully!", Pre-filled balance was: "₹137.00"

description: Order fully paid: Record Payment button removed and status updated to paid
expected: Status badge displays Paid, Record Payment button disappears since balance is zero
actual: Paid status verified: true, Remaining record buttons: 0

description: Customer views pending order bill and payment guidance
expected: Presents approved Cash on Delivery (COD) doorstep guidance; Razorpay gateway and manual customer self-confirmation are absent
actual: Verified: Customer presented with approved Cash on Delivery guidance; online gateway and self-confirm inputs are strictly disabled

description: Doorstep COD collection by assigned delivery associate
expected: record_order_payment succeeds, status: confirmed, orders.payment_status = "paid", paid_amount_paise = 15800
actual: RPC status: confirmed, order.payment_status: paid, paid_amount: 15800

description: Record partial payment of ₹100.00 against ₹316.00 bill
expected: order.payment_status becomes "partially_paid", paid_amount_paise = 10000, remaining balance = 21600 (₹216.00)
actual: order.payment_status: partially_paid, paid_amount: 10000, remaining: 21600

description: Multiple payment entries in public.payments ledger sum correctly on order
expected: Two distinct payment rows in ledger (10000 + 5000 = 15000 paise paid)
actual: Ledger rows count: 2, total paid on order: 15000

description: Pay remaining ₹166.00 balance on Order #SW-PART-001
expected: Order transitions to "paid", paid_amount_paise = 31600 (₹316.00)
actual: order.payment_status: paid, paid_amount: 31600

description: Attempting to record additional payment on already fully settled order
expected: Database raises exception: "Order #... is already fully paid"
actual: Exception caught: "Order #SW-PART-001 is already fully paid (Total: 31600 paise, Paid: 31600 paise)."

description: Attempting to record balance payment on an order not yet weighed and billed
expected: Database raises exception: "Cannot record balance payment: Order #... has not yet been weighed and billed"
actual: Exception caught: "Cannot record balance payment: Order #SW-UNBILLED-01 has not yet been weighed and billed. Record an advance payment instead."

description: Attempting to record negative or zero payment amount (-500 paise)
expected: Database raises exception: "Payment amount must be a positive integer in paise"
actual: Exception caught: "Payment amount must be a positive integer in paise (received: -500)."

description: Attempting to reuse existing UPI UTR reference ("UTR-PART-999") on a different order
expected: Database raises exception: "Duplicate payment: UPI transaction reference ... has already been recorded for another order"
actual: Exception caught: "Duplicate payment: UPI transaction reference UTR-PART-999 has already been recorded for another order."

description: Exact replay returns cached response; conflicting parameters with same key rejected
expected: Exact replay returns idempotent_replay: true; conflict throws "Idempotency conflict"
actual: Replay response: true, Conflict exception: "Idempotency conflict: Key idemp-part-01 was previously used with different payment parameters."

description: Customer attempts to confirm cash payment directly via record_order_payment
expected: Database raises exception: "Unauthorized: Customers cannot record cash payments directly"
actual: Exception caught: "Unauthorized: Customers cannot record cash payments directly. Cash must be collected and confirmed by store staff."

description: Customer attempts to execute record_order_refund on Order #SW-COD-001
expected: Database raises exception: "Unauthorized: Only store managers and owners can execute refunds"
actual: Exception caught: "Unauthorized: Only store managers and owners can execute refunds."

description: Direct UPDATE on orders.paid_amount_paise bypassing record_order_payment RPC
expected: Database trigger aborts with: "Security violation: Direct payment field modification is prohibited"
actual: Exception caught: "Security violation: Direct payment field modification is prohibited. Payments must be processed through record_order_payment()."

description: Store manager executes partial refund of ₹58.00 on Order #SW-COD-001 (paid ₹158.00)
expected: Order net paid drops to ₹100.00 (10000 paise), payment_status becomes "partially_refunded"
actual: order.payment_status: partially_refunded, paid_amount: 10000

description: Store manager executes remaining ₹100.00 refund on Order #SW-COD-001
expected: Order net paid drops to 0, payment_status transitions to "refunded"
actual: order.payment_status: refunded, paid_amount: 0

description: Attempting to execute further refund on fully refunded order
expected: Database raises exception: "Refund rejected: Order #... has no remaining refundable balance"
actual: Exception caught: "Refund rejected: Order #SW-COD-001 has no remaining refundable balance (Paid: 15800 paise, Already refunded: 15800 paise)."

description: Audit-grade reconciliation: Sum(Confirmed Payments) - Sum(Refunds) == Sum(orders.paid_amount_paise)
expected: 100% exact match between payments ledger net sum and orders net paid sum
actual: Invoiced: ₹632.00, Confirmed Payments: ₹632.00, Refunds: ₹158.00, Ledger Net: ₹474.00, Orders Net: ₹474.00
